answer: At dawn each new agent must answer a challenge seeded by a value nobody can predict, then post a copper-denominated bond that unlocks only after it grades a stranger's submission correctly. Cheap clones fail here: they appear together and cluster on the same knoll of phrasing, so a correlation test slashes every bond in that cluster at once. An honest agent pays the bond once; a sybil farm must pay it for every identity it wants to keep.
